name: ProductionArea - Default (seed v2)
description: A production structure's yield area (yield areas P4, #138): its shape and bounding box. The area model comes from the structure's kind; the level caps the size (blocks, volume or radius). A polygon's points are captured in game or sent through the API. Seed v2 (#877): the region field captures a region in game (RegionClaim), the radius field a centre and radius (CaptureRadius); a Region-shaped area takes its bounds from the region.

steps.description: Which structure the area belongs to and what it is called.

fields.label: Production structure
fields.description: The structure it belongs to (it must have a production kind). An area can't move to another structure.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique per structure, e.g. North field.

fields.label: Shape
fields.description: Region (a WorldGuard region and its bounds), Cuboid (two corners), Polygon (points and a height range) or Radius (around a centre).

fields.label: Exclusive
fields.description: Exclusive areas may not overlap other exclusive areas of the same model. Empty = the kind's setting.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off = never surveyed and no yield from it.

steps.description: Fill the fields of the chosen shape.

fields.label: WorldGuard region
fields.description: Shape Region: the region's id. Use Send to Minecraft to pick the region in game; its bounds are taken from the region when the minimum and maximum are left empty.

fields.label: Radius
fields.description: Shape Radius: the radius in blocks (1 to 1024). Use Send to Minecraft to capture the centre and radius in game.

fields.label: Centre X
fields.description: Shape Radius: empty = the structure's Location.

fields.label: Centre Y
fields.description: Shape Radius: empty = the structure's Location.

fields.label: Centre Z
fields.description: Shape Radius: empty = the structure's Location.

fields.label: Min X
fields.description: Region and Cuboid: a corner (any order). For a Region shape, leave empty to take the region's bounds.

fields.label: Min Y
fields.description: Region, Cuboid and Polygon: the bottom; Radius: empty = the world's bottom. For a Region shape, leave empty to take the region's bounds.

fields.label: Min Z
fields.description: Region and Cuboid: a corner. For a Region shape, leave empty to take the region's bounds.

fields.label: Max X
fields.description: Region and Cuboid: the opposite corner. For a Region shape, leave empty to take the region's bounds.

fields.label: Max Y
fields.description: Region, Cuboid and Polygon: the top; Radius: empty = the world's top. For a Region shape, leave empty to take the region's bounds.

fields.label: Max Z
fields.description: Region and Cuboid: the opposite corner. For a Region shape, leave empty to take the region's bounds.
